title: Atelier Ryza 2: Lost Legends & the Secret Fairy
synopsis: Gust’s second Ryza adventure and the first Atelier with a returning protagonist — retained as the Koei Tecmo Nintendo Switch game card.

catalog.originalTitle: ライザのアトリエ２ ～失われた伝承と秘密の妖精～

custody.physical: Nintendo Switch game card in retail case

curatorNotes:
Atelier Ryza 2 returns to Reisalin Stout three years after Atelier Ryza: Ever Darkness & the Secret Hideout, and is the first game in the Atelier series to bring back its protagonist. It is the second chapter of the “Secret” storyline, built around ruin exploration and synthesis.

Koei Tecmo released it in Japan on December 3, 2020, simultaneously on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, and PlayStation 5, and in North America on January 26, 2021.

The filing extends the Atelier holdings on the shelf, under the same series authority as Atelier Lulua and the Gust PlayStation 2 games.
collectionNotes:
The retained object is Koei Tecmo’s retail edition of Atelier Ryza 2 on a Nintendo Switch game card.

Dedicated artifact views of the individual copy have not yet been filed; the gallery below is held open for that documentation.

preservation.playableOn: Nintendo Switch; compatible Nintendo Switch family hardware
preservation.compatibility: Nintendo Switch software is region-free. The retained game card is the primary access copy and runs on any Nintendo Switch console.
preservation.concerns: Game cards are flash media; long-term charge retention, contact wear, and loss of the small card from its case are the principal risks. Any content delivered as an eShop download or update depends on Nintendo’s servers and is not preserved by the card alone.
preservation.knownRevisions: Released in Japan on December 3, 2020 as ライザのアトリエ２ ～失われた伝承と秘密の妖精～; North America January 26, 2021, Europe January 29, 2021. A twelve-item season pass followed from March 2021, and a separate DX edition was issued in November 2025.
preservation.availability: Distributed at retail by Koei Tecmo, with a digital edition on the Nintendo eShop.
